name: kalker
description: Advanced scientific calculator with math syntax, user-defined variables and functions

kalker.description: Scientific calculator with support for variables, functions, complex numbers, and calculus operations
kalker.usage:
kalker # Start interactive calculator
kalker "2 + 2" # Evaluate expression directly
kalker "f(x) = x^2; f(5)" # Define function and use it
kalker "x = 5; y = 10; x * y" # Use variables
kalker "derivative(x^2, x)" # Calculate derivatives
kalker "integral(x^2, x, 0, 1)" # Calculate definite integrals
kalker "sqrt(-1)" # Complex number support
kalker "[1, 2, 3] + [4, 5, 6]" # Vector operations
